scope: NSE/BSE Indian equities only; ISIN identifies issuer so exchange cross-listings are not independent stocks. Research-only; no serving changes or automatic promotion.
purpose: Compare frozen champion against official Indian index/strategy alternatives, transparent factor rules, standard international ML baselines, licensed foreign sequence/relationship architectures, prior attempted policies and commercial-score evidence where available.
evidence_tiers: Existing current-survivor44-date SIP panel: retrospective comparative diagnostic
Matched512-issuer OHLCV sequence cohort: foreign-model adaptation diagnostic, not architecture-paper replication
Official index TRI histories: same-contribution-date investment comparison, launch-era vs backfilled history separate
Commercial rankers without dated score archives: untested; present scores cannot be backcast
PIT historical membership/terminal-price reconstruction: still incomplete, cannot certify survivorship-free alpha

periods.training: 2016 onward, actual outcome endpoints strictly before test-year January1
periods.exposed: 2024-2025 already exposed; no parameter search on these dates
periods.fresh: Existing ledger frozenOct3 inputs remain ineligible; no fresh score holdout claimed

objectives: return: within-query percentile of future SIP XIRR

model_budget.training_cap_rule: Select whole date/profile/sector queries in deterministic seeded hash order until budget exhausted; same selected training queries for every new algorithm/objective; retain all test rows. Full champion training history differs; include matched-budget LightGBM and disclose this asymmetry.
model_budget.early_stopping: None using exposed labels; fixed epochs/hyperparameters. Record resource failures honestly.

goals: Brier/logloss/ECE using strictly past calibration only, probabilities not percentile ranks
risk: daily marked-portfolio drawdown where real daily paths available; never substitute mean asset drawdown

portfolio: Sparse query evaluation uses matched individual-stock future SIP labels. This is not a portfolio XIRR or daily portfolio Sharpe. Official TRI comparisons use actual forward contribution schedule, fractional benchmark units and same dates; index returns cannot produce stock-ranking IC. Additional executable path checks require real matching paths and receipt their basis.
costs: Scenario sensitivity at0/10/25/50basis points per buy and sale, not certified historical Indian brokerage/tax/slippage. Recompute cashflows when available; otherwise mark unavailable rather than subtract bps from XIRR. No tax-adjusted claim.
calibration: For each annual testY, use independent mature out-of-time scores with endpoint<Jan1Y, at least2distinct calibration dates; logistic calibration fixedC=.1. No contemporaneous outcome-based climatology, no percentile-as-probability.
primary_gate: Select on development only. Challenger must improve Top3 attainment by at least0.0063048666 or IC by at least0.010134924, not worsen the other primary metric or mean selected-asset drawdown; positive paired familywise date-block lower bound for its improvement; then same locked challenger must satisfy nonworse attainment/IC/drawdown in exposed. Otherwise retain champion. A ranking win does not imply dominance in all objectives.
uncertainty: 4000 paired365/730-calendar-day circular block resamples preserving models/sectors/profiles jointly. Recompute familywise selection-noise hurdle for this larger registered family. Existing35-model hurdles are historical operational reference only, not universal significance.
literature: Wide primary-source review: classic factors; modern cross-sectional ML; temporal/graph/market-conditioned models; foundation models; costs/portfolio construction; leakage/calibration/multiple testing; Indian exchange methodologies and commercial historical-score availability. Record citation, geography, inputs, licensing, adaptation, failures and evidence status. No claim of exhaustive all-market superiority.
forbidden: No synthetic or invented competitor histories
No pretrained foreign weights treated as clean pretraining cutoff
No using paper China/US IC as a comparable Indian result
No relabeling price indices as TRI
